pilot.name: Shirley Xu
pilot.source: Reported by Ken Tam in this conversation on October 26, 2026; not independently observed by the submission assistant.
pilot.scenario: Her own house, using a 2D floor plan with dimensions.
pilot.outcome: Ken reports that she successfully found furniture using the app.

competitors.name: IKEA Kreativ
competitors.facts: Free room designer supports room photos, scans, manual dimensions and prebuilt rooms; erases existing furniture and designs on the real room.

competitors.name: IKEA Kreativ
competitors.facts: Official description includes erasing existing furniture and positioning/swapping IKEA furnishings.

competitors.name: Planner 5D
competitors.facts: AI recognition converts a 2D plan into an editable 3D project on paid plans. Documentation recommends bird's-eye view and dimensions, warns renders/elevations cannot be properly recreated.

competitors.name: Cona
competitors.facts: First-party page directly verified October 26: drawing/upload/scanning, real brands IKEA CB2 Herman Miller with prices and purchase links, browser 2D/3D, AI auto-furnish; asks for one real measurement for scale. Close overlap; no superiority claim or hands-on comparative test.

novelty_position: A useful combination for renters: public building-plan discovery, explicit uncertainty/provenance, budget-aware choices from several retailers, editable arrangements and portable checklist. Not first AI room planner, not superior or exclusive feature coverage proven by competitive testing. No hands-on competitor benchmark conducted.
